newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Treasury bill auction further delayed.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Treasury bill auction further delayed.

text.p: The regular weekly auction of Philippine treasury bills was delayed by another 30 minutes to 2.0 p.m.(0600 GMT) on Monday because of communications problems, an official said.
Earlier, the auction had been reset to 1.30 p.m. from 1.0 p.m.
Bureau of Treasury director Roberto Juanchito Dispo said the communications problems, which had prevented some banks from sending their bids on time, still persisted.
The bellwether 91-day treasury bill posted a yield of 10.529 percent at the last auction on June 2 and money market traders said they expected rates to fall at today's auction.
